grade1-2: Participate in conversations and oral presentations
grade3-4: Read and understand different text types with increasing complexity
Write structured texts with beginning, middle and end
Explore Norwegian grammar: parts of speech, sentence structure
grade5-7: Analyse and interpret literary texts, including themes and characters
Write argumentative, narrative and informational texts
Explore Norwegian language history (bokmål and nynorsk)
Discuss media texts and digital communication critically
grade8-10: Analyse texts from different periods and genres (including Ibsen, Bjørnson, Hamsun)
Write extended analytical and argumentative essays
Explore the development of Norwegian from Old Norse to modern Norwegian
Critically evaluate sources and persuasive techniques
Use both bokmål and nynorsk in writing

note: Norwegian students must write in both bokmål and nynorsk (Sidemål). This should be reflected in writing assignments.
